title: Business fundamentals
learning_outcomes: Explain customer value in the context of business fundamentals.
Compare and distinguish revenue cost margin in the context of business fundamentals.
Apply business functions in the context of business fundamentals.
Evaluate and justify decisions about unit economics in the context of business fundamentals.

lessons.title: Customer value
lessons.outcome: Explain customer value in the context of business fundamentals.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving customer value; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to business model sheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain customer value from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of customer value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Revenue cost margin
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish revenue cost margin in the context of business fundamentals.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving revenue cost margin; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to business model sheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain revenue cost margin from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of revenue cost margin; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Business functions
lessons.outcome: Apply business functions in the context of business fundamentals.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving business functions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to business model sheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain business functions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of business functions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Unit economics
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about unit economics in the context of business fundamentals.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving unit economics; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to business model sheet.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain unit economics from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of unit economics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of customer value; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of revenue cost margin; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of business functions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of unit economics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
